mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_task ( task_id, task_type, task_status, user_id, merchant_id, conversation_id, thread_id, current_run_id, lease_token, input_json, next_action, workflow_version, idempotency_key ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{taskType}, #{taskStatus}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{conversationId}, #{threadId}, #{currentRunId}, #{leaseToken}, #{inputJson}, #{nextAction}, #{workflowVersion}, #{idempotencyKey} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_type = VALUES(task_type), task_status = 'QUEUED', input_json = VALUES(input_json), next_action = VALUES(next_action), thread_id = VALUES(thread_id), current_run_id = VALUES(current_run_id), lease_token = VALUES(lease_token), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, cancel_requested_at = NULL, cancel_reason = NULL, pause_requested_at = NULL, pause_reason = NULL, finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', current_run_id = #{runId}, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_owner = #{workerId}, workflow_version = #{workflow}, last_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lease_expires_at = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE ai_task SET cancel_requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), cancel_reason = #{reason}, pause_requested_at = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, task_type, task_status, user_id, merchant_id, conversation_id, thread_id, current_run_id, lease_token, lease_owner, input_json, next_action, workflow_version, result_json, error_code, error_message, pause_reason, cancel_reason, pause_requested_at, cancel_requested_at FROM ai_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET task_status = #{taskStatus}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lease_token = NULL, lease_owner = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
